items.example: You hid my keys? Real mature.
items.simple: You say it when someone acts like a child.
dialogue: A: I put your lunch in the freezer.
B: Real mature.
A: It's just a joke!
items.note: The Office ve Brooklyn Nine-Nine'da iğneleme.

items.example: He says he was sick, but I'm not buying it.
items.simple: You do not believe what someone says.
dialogue: A: I was stuck in a lift.
B: I'm not buying it.
A: Ask the building manager.
items.note: Brooklyn Nine-Nine'da şüpheli sorgularında.

items.example: Get a grip. It's only a haircut.
items.exampleTr: Kendine gel. Sadece bir saç kesimi.
items.simple: You tell someone to calm down and think clearly.
dialogue: A: My life is over!
B: Get a grip. It's just a cold.
A: But I have a meeting!
items.note: Friends'te panik anlarında arkadaşların tepkisi.

items.en: make a big deal out of
items.example: Why do you always make a big deal out of everything?
items.simple: You act like a small thing is very, very important.
dialogue: A: You forgot my birthday!
B: Don't make a big deal out of it.
A: It IS a big deal!
items.note: Aile kavgalarında (Modern Family) sık geçer.

items.example: You're blowing things out of proportion again.
items.simple: You make a small problem seem much bigger than it is.
dialogue: A: He didn't say hi. He hates me.
B: You always blow things out of proportion.
A: Maybe he was busy.
items.note: Dramatik karakterlere (Ross, Sheldon) söylenir.

items.en: It's not what it looks like
items.example: It's not what it looks like. I can explain.
items.simple: You say this when people think you did something bad, but you did not.
dialogue: A: Why are you in her room?
B: It's not what it looks like.
A: Then what is it?
items.note: Friends ve Seinfeld'te klasik yanlış anlaşılma sahnesi.

items.example: Before you shout, I can explain.
items.simple: You say you have a reason for what people see.
dialogue: A: Why is the oven on fire?
B: I can explain.
A: You have ten seconds.
items.note: Malcolm in the Middle'da yakalanma anlarında.

items.example: I need to come up with an excuse fast.
items.simple: You think of a reason that is not true, very quickly.
dialogue: A: Mom's calling. What do I say?
B: Come up with an excuse.
A: Say the Wi-Fi is down.
items.note: Seinfeld'te George'un en bilindik uğraşı.

items.example: I totally forgot about our meeting. I'm so sorry.
items.simple: You did not remember at all.
dialogue: A: You were supposed to call me.
B: I totally forgot.
A: That's the third time.
items.note: Bahane sahnelerinin vazgeçilmezi.

items.example: This is between us. Stay out of it.
items.simple: You tell a person not to get into a problem that is not theirs.
dialogue: A: Mom, tell him to stop!
B: Stay out of it, both of you.
A: But he started it!
items.note: Modern Family'de kardeş kavgalarında.

items.example: Mind your own business, please.
items.simple: You tell someone not to ask about private things.
dialogue: A: Who was that on the phone?
B: Mind your own business.
A: It was your girlfriend!
items.note: Seinfeld ve Malcolm in the Middle'da komşu/aile.

items.example: I lost. You don't have to rub it in.
items.simple: You keep talking about someone's mistake, so they feel bad.
dialogue: A: I told you it would rain.
B: Don't rub it in.
A: I'm only smiling.
items.note: Friends'te Ross ve Chandler tarzı kavgalarda.

items.example: For the record, I never said that.
items.exampleTr: Kayıtlara geçsin, ben bunu hiç söylemedim.
items.simple: You say it so people know the true story.
dialogue: A: You ate all the cookies.
B: For the record, it was three.
A: Out of twelve!
items.note: Brooklyn Nine-Nine ve The Office'te savunma cümlesi.

items.example: The boss's new rules? Don't get me started.
items.exampleTr: Patronun yeni kuralları mı? Açtırma bana.
items.simple: You have a lot of angry things to say about it.
dialogue: A: How was the airline?
B: Don't get me started.
A: That bad?
items.note: The Office'te çalışanların şikâyet tarzı.

items.example: I told you so! That plan was never going to work.
items.exampleTr: Ben demiştim! O plan hiç işe yaramayacaktı.
items.simple: You said it before, and you were right.
dialogue: A: The picnic is ruined by rain.
B: I told you so.
A: Please, stop smiling.
items.note: Aile komedilerinde (Modern Family, Malcolm) çok duyulur.

items.example: I walk on eggshells around my boss.
items.simple: You are very careful so someone does not get angry.
dialogue: A: Why is everyone so quiet?
B: We walk on eggshells when Dad is angry.
A: I'll go to my room.
items.note: The Office ve Malcolm in the Middle'da gergin ortam.

items.example: She had a meltdown when her cake fell.
items.simple: You get so upset that you cry or shout a lot.
dialogue: A: Is she okay?
B: She might have a meltdown.
A: Hide the dishes.
items.note: Big Bang Theory'de Sheldon ve Friends'te Monica.

items.tr: bana biraz anlayış göster, üstüme gitme
items.example: Cut me some slack. It's my first day.
items.exampleTr: Bana biraz anlayış göster. İlk günüm.
items.simple: You ask someone to be less strict with you.
dialogue: A: You're late again.
B: Cut me some slack. The train broke.
A: Fine, but only today.
items.note: The Office ve Brooklyn Nine-Nine'da sık duyulur.

items.example: I'll sleep on it and tell you tomorrow.
items.simple: You wait until the next day before you decide.
dialogue: A: Do you want the job?
B: Let me sleep on it.
A: Okay, call me tomorrow.
items.note: Karar anlarında sık geçen kalıp.

items.tr: Ben de onu diyorum (çift anlamlı espri)
items.example: That was hard to get in. That's what she said.
items.exampleTr: İçeri girmesi zordu. Ben de onu diyorum.
items.simple: A joke people make when a sentence can sound rude.
dialogue: A: It's too big. It won't fit.
B: That's what she said.
A: Michael, please stop.
items.note: The Office'te Michael Scott'ın ikonik esprisi.

items.example: Wow, thanks a lot. You ate my dinner.
items.simple: You say thank you, but you really feel angry.
dialogue: A: I told your boss about the mistake.
B: Wow, thanks a lot.
A: He would have found out.
items.note: Seinfeld ve Modern Family'de alaycı teşekkür.

items.example: Come on, you're being dramatic. It's just a scratch.
items.exampleTr: Hadi ama abartıyorsun. Sadece bir çizik.
items.simple: You act like a small thing is a very big problem.
dialogue: A: My whole life is ruined!
B: You're being dramatic.
A: I broke a nail!
items.note: Modern Family'de aile içi laf.

items.example: Whatever you say, boss.
items.simple: You agree, but you do not really care or you are annoyed.
dialogue: A: We do it my way.
B: Whatever you say.
A: Why do you sound upset?
items.note: The Office ve Brooklyn Nine-Nine'da tavır cümlesi.

items.example: Oh, come on! That's not fair.
items.simple: You do not agree, or you ask for help.
dialogue: A: You can't come with us.
B: Oh, come on!
A: Rules are rules.
items.note: Her dizide en çok duyulanlardan.

items.example: Are you serious right now? You lost the tickets?
items.exampleTr: Şimdi ciddi misin? Biletleri kaybettin mi?
items.simple: You are shocked and a little angry about what you hear.
dialogue: A: I forgot the keys inside.
B: Are you serious right now?
A: I'll call a locksmith.
items.note: Modern Family'de öfke/şaşkınlık.

items.example: If you're late, not my problem.
items.simple: You do not want to help or care about a trouble.
dialogue: A: I can't find my homework.
B: Not my problem.
A: You hid it!
items.note: Seinfeld ve Malcolm in the Middle'da.
